integrity: Universal carry-state proof, exact finite independent transition enumeration, literature comparison; independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Isomorphism for the stated quadratic parameter family only; no classification of all isomorphic pairs and no claim of digit-label identity. The generating function was known for Y(8,5). Unlocated equivalent proofs remain possible.
title: An eight-state Young-graph family resolving the \(Y(8,5)\) isomorphism conjecture
